visualCharacteristics.purpose: News story list (News from Mayo Clinic): small square thumbnail beside a linked title
visualCharacteristics.description: Stacked rows; a rounded square thumbnail on the left and an underlined blue story title on the right. The whole row is clickable.

contentPattern.structure: One row per story: image | link
contentPattern.description: Look-alike story items whose count varies by page, so Cards. The H2 above stays default content. The thumbnail is decorative (the title names the story).

usage: News or story list under a default-content H2.
reuseGuidance: Use for a compact list of linked items each with a small thumbnail. For image tiles in a grid use cards-overlay or cards-action.
